name: כל השורשים השלישיים – ערך מוחלט וארגומנט בטבלה (באנגלית)

functions.name: cxTX
functions.body: first(args(e))

functions.name: cxsq
functions.body: block([f,m:1,s:1], if n=1 then [1,1] else (f:ifactors(n), for p in f do (m:m*p[1]^floor(p[2]/2), s:s*p[1]^mod(p[2],2)), [m,s]))

functions.name: cxrat
functions.body: if integerp(y) then string(y) else sconcat(if y<0 then "-" else "", "\\frac{", abs(num(y)), "}{", denom(y), "}")

functions.name: cxtx
functions.body: if float(x)<0 then sconcat("-",tex1(-x)) else tex1(x)

functions.name: cxnn
functions.body: block([q,ms,c,g,ps,y], y:ratsimp(radcan(x)), if ratnump(y) then cxrat(y) else (q:ratsimp(radcan(x^2)), if not ratnump(q) or q<0 then cxtx(x) else (g:if float(x)<0 then "-" else "", ms:cxsq(num(q)*denom(q)), c:ms[1]/denom(q), ps:sconcat(if num(c)=1 then "" else string(num(c)), "\\sqrt{", ms[2], "}"), if denom(c)=1 then sconcat(g,ps) else sconcat(g,"\\frac{",ps,"}{",denom(c),"}"))))

functions.name: cxpa
functions.body: if float(x)<0 then sconcat("\\left(",cxnn(x),"\\right)") else cxnn(x)

functions.name: cxi
functions.body: block([s], b:if float(b)<0 then -b else b, if b=1 then "\\mathrm{i}" else (s:cxnn(b), sconcat(s, if integerp(ratsimp(radcan(b))) then "" else "\\,", "\\mathrm{i}")))

functions.name: cxs
functions.body: block([a,b], z:rectform(z), a:realpart(z), b:imagpart(z), if b=0 then cxnn(a) elseif a=0 then sconcat(if float(b)<0 then "-" else "", cxi(b)) else sconcat(cxnn(a), if float(b)<0 then "-" else "+", cxi(b)))

functions.name: cxps
functions.body: block([a,b], z:rectform(z), a:realpart(z), b:imagpart(z), if (a=0 or b=0) and float(a+b)>=0 then cxs(z) else sconcat("\\left(",cxs(z),"\\right)"))

functions.name: cxas
functions.body: block([c,p,ps,g], c:ratsimp(x/%pi), if not ratnump(c) then cxtx(x) elseif c=0 then "0" else (g:if c<0 then "-" else "", p:abs(num(c)), ps:sconcat(if p=1 then "" else p, "\\pi"), if denom(c)=1 then sconcat(g,ps) else sconcat(g,"\\frac{",ps,"}{",denom(c),"}")))

functions.name: cx
functions.body: TX(cxs(z))

functions.name: cxp
functions.body: TX(cxps(z))

functions.name: cxn
functions.body: TX(cxnn(x))

functions.name: cxa
functions.body: TX(cxas(x))

functions.name: cxP
functions.body: TX(cxpa(x))

functions.name: cxrt
functions.body: block([s:cxnn(sqrt(N)), t:sconcat("\\sqrt{",cxrat(N),"}")], TX(if s=t then t else sconcat(t,"=",s)))

functions.name: cxpq
functions.body: if float(x)<0 or not integerp(ratsimp(x)) then sconcat("\\left(",cxnn(x),"\\right)") else cxnn(x)

functions.name: cxQ
functions.body: TX(cxpq(x))

functions.name: cxugly
functions.body: is(ssearch("^{\\frac",tex1(x))#false)

functions.name: cxquad
functions.body: block([x:float(realpart(rectform(z))), y:float(imagpart(rectform(z)))], if abs(x)<1e-12 then (if y>0 then 5 else 6) elseif abs(y)<1e-12 then (if x>0 then 7 else 8) elseif x>0 then (if y>0 then 1 else 4) else (if y>0 then 2 else 3))

functions.name: cxmod
functions.body: TX(sconcat("\\sqrt{",cxpq(realpart(rectform(z))),"^2+",cxpq(imagpart(rectform(z))),"^2}"))

questiontext:
Consider the complex number

\[ z = {{CT:0}}. \]

Give the modulus and argument of all its cube roots.

Use each row in the table below to specify a cube root, with the modulus in the first column and the argument in the second. Each argument should be entered as a multiple of \(\pi\) and should fall in the interval \([-\pi,\pi ]\).

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]

How to enter: each entry in its own box: a number, a fraction (e.g. 1/2) or an expression (e.g. sqrt(2)).
generalfeedback:
Outline: Write \(z\) in polar form; by De Moivre's theorem its cube roots have modulus \(\sqrt[3]{|z|}\) and arguments \(\frac{\arg z+2\pi k}{3}\), for three consecutive values of \(k\).
Step 1 — Polar form of z
Here \(z={{CT:0}}\), and its modulus is

\[ |z|={{CT:1}}={{CT:2}} \]

The argument depends on the quadrant of the point \(({{CT:3}},{{CT:4}})\) in the complex plane. [[if test="{{CT:15}}"]]Let \(\alpha\) be the acute angle between the segment from the origin to the point \(({{CT:3}},{{CT:4}})\) and the \(x\)-axis:

\[ \alpha=\arctan\left|\frac{y}{x}\right|=\arctan {{CT:5}}={{CT:6}} \]

[[/if]][[if test="{{CT:16}}"]]The real part is positive and the imaginary part is positive, so the point is in the first quadrant and \(\arg z=\alpha\). [[/if]][[if test="{{CT:17}}"]]The real part is negative and the imaginary part is positive, so the point is in the second quadrant and \(\arg z=\pi-\alpha\). [[/if]][[if test="{{CT:18}}"]]The real part is negative and the imaginary part is negative, so the point is in the third quadrant and \(\arg z=-(\pi-\alpha)\). [[/if]][[if test="{{CT:19}}"]]The real part is positive and the imaginary part is negative, so the point is in the fourth quadrant and \(\arg z=-\alpha\). [[/if]][[if test="{{CT:20}}"]]The real part is 0 and the imaginary part is positive, so the point lies on the positive imaginary axis. [[/if]][[if test="{{CT:21}}"]]The real part is 0 and the imaginary part is negative, so the point lies on the negative imaginary axis. [[/if]]Hence

\[ \arg z={{CT:7}} \]

Step 2 — The cube roots
Adding a multiple of \(2\pi\) to the argument does not change \(z\), so \(z={{CT:2}}\left(\cos\varphi+i\sin\varphi\right)\) for each of \(\varphi={{CT:7}},\ {{CT:8}},\ {{CT:9}}\). By De Moivre's theorem, \(w=\rho\left(\cos\psi+i\sin\psi\right)\) satisfies \(w^3=z\) when \(\rho^3=|z|\) and \(3\psi\) is one of these angles. So every cube root has modulus

\[ \rho=\sqrt[3]{{{CT:2}}}={{CT:10}} \]

and argument one third of an argument of \(z\):

\[ \frac{{{CT:7}}}{3}={{CT:11}},\qquad \frac{{{CT:8}}}{3}={{CT:12}},\qquad \frac{{{CT:9}}}{3}={{CT:13}} \]

These three arguments differ by \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) and all lie in \([-\pi,\pi]\), so they give the three different cube roots (other multiples of \(2\pi\) repeat them). Each row of the table is one root, and the order of the rows does not matter:

\[ {{CT:14}} \]
